```{r}


# Control Structures 
?runif

# If condition
x<-runif(20,0,100)
x
hist(x)
y<-rnorm(100)
hist(y)
mean(y)
sd(y)


x1<-runif(1,0,10)
x1
if(x1>3){
  print("x1 is greater than three")
} else {
  print(" x1 is less or equal to three")
}

# For condition

x<-c("a","b","c","d")


# while

count<-1
while (count<10){
print(count)
count<-count+1
}

###### set seed

z<-5
set.seed(1)
while (z>=3 && z<= 10) {
coin
}

#Next and Break

for (i in 1:100){
  print(1:i)
}
if (i>20){
  break
}


```
